purpose: r13 summary retention Part B (2026-10-02, plan SUMMARY_BOUNDS_AND_RETENTION v5): every prune that appends a summary now records prunedContextSummaryCoverage on its anchor (persisted bookkeeping, never rendered, never in a request). The frozen lifecycle driver commits one prune summary in each listed scenario and never holds more than three anchors, so nothing is demoted. Candidate-side only: exactly one coverage object is removed from each listed scenario's durable, snapshot and rawConversation views (rawConversation by exact byte removal of the key and its value); no capture may carry a coverage or demotion key; no observation may carry demotedPruneSummaries. Everything else is compared by the earlier rules unchanged.
